title: P1 Common Decision Envelope
description: Required output of every arm (A, A+, B) for every case. Primary scoring depends ONLY on this envelope plus the isolated answer key (O-2 sections 3.3, 3.7, 4.1). Arm-specific additional output lives beside, never inside, this object. NOTE: this subschema is open (no additionalProperties:false) so arm schemas can compose it via allOf; each complete arm schema closes the composed object with unevaluatedProperties:false.

selected_option.description: Must be one of the case's option-menu keys. Enforced at runtime against the case file, not statically.

cited_source_ids.description: Required whenever the case supplies named sources; may be empty for cases without named sources (e.g., pure formal cases).

proposed_action.description: Secondary diagnostic only (O-2 section 3.7): compared against gold action_authorizable; structurally incapable of altering primary category-error scoring or claim coverage.
